text:
maya.marketing: Draft of the new product launch post is ready for review — quick ask: copy, benchmark wording, webinar CTA and inbound routing. Draft: https://notion.redwood/drafts/launch-inference (do not share yet).

eli.design: skimmed it — solid. small ask: can we swap the hero to a latency vs cost chart instead of the abstract city image? helps with benchmarking narrative. :+1:

jonas.product: Copy looks tight. Two product notes: 1) change 'we solved latency' phrasing to something like 'reduces tail latency with graceful fallbacks'; 2) the "2.3x cost" claim needs a short methodology blurb or a qualifier.

priya.eng: On the benchmarks: the 2.3x is median across our customer-like load when using KV prefix caching on A100s with int8 quant. I'll add a short appendix. Example command we ran: `./bench --model mix-medium --seq 1024 --batch 8 --cache-prefix on`

natalie.corpcomms: Important: get legal signoff on the customer quote and on the exact SLA/latency numbers. Also we need an embargo window and a comms plan for the webinar signups (who owns lead routing?).

maya.marketing: Updated the draft with your edits (link above). @natalie.corpcomms — can you run legal check on the quote and embargo? @publish-bot can you schedule a short sync for copy + benchmarks?

publish-bot: Meeting created: "Copy + Benchmarks Review" Mon Mar 25 09:30 PT — attendees maya.marketing, jonas.product, priya.eng, eli.design, natalie.corpcomms. Calendar invites sent.

jonas.product: Minor nit: change 'zero-downtime rollouts' -> 'canary rollouts with automatic fallback' (more accurate). Also add one sentence about smart routing to cheaper model variants under high load.

eli.design: Hero caption suggestion: "High-throughput LLM inference across hosted and private infrastructure". Also will prepare a compact chart (p50/p95 vs cost) for the blog.

maya.marketing: Plan: freeze copy EOD Friday. If legal clears the quote we include it; otherwise we use anonymized paraphrase. Companion webinar will be linked as the primary CTA and will route inbound signups to SDR queue `Launch-Webinars`. We'll add UTM params and a webhook to the CRM.

priya.eng: I'll stub a reproducibility appendix with exact configs and raw aggregated percentiles (no per-request traces). Will include quantization notes: `int8` reduced memory 4x in our runs.

natalie.corpcomms: Legal DM: customer approved paraphrase but asked to remove raw sample latencies — only publish aggregate percentiles and config matrix. Also requested embargo: 2026-03-30 08:00 PT.

maya.marketing: Thanks all — freezing copy now and pushing to staging for final proofread. I'll post the final link here when up. :sparkles: 

jonas.product: Product approved from my side — feel free to ship when legal clears. :rocket:
